current_evaluator.training_preprocessing: feature means and scales fit on the training window only
current_evaluator.fit: ridge-regularized linear model with deterministic Gaussian elimination

gates.origin_local_conditioning: required at every estimator origin; aggregate lane fails closed if any required origin is inadmissible
gates.hypothesis_preservation: adaptive projection may be used only for a separately declared projected estimand unless every required origin preserves the declared coefficient-space hypothesis
gates.finite_sample_null_support: formal directional calibration requires a supported finite-sample equal-risk null point under the declared nuisance policy
gates.estimated_nuisance_null: nuisance-estimated restricted-null calibration requires its own validation; oracle calibration is not sufficient
gates.uniform_null_surface: a single directional or null point is insufficient for direction-free composite equal-accuracy inference
gates.least_favorable: finite direction-grid maxima remain diagnostic; no least-favorable critical value is authorized
gates.weak_identification: near-zero curvature / weakly identified regions require explicit robust calibration rather than ordinary bootstrap inheritance
gates.null_surface_eigenstructure: Q curvature and R=bb'-4cQ discriminant geometry must be characterized before direction-free uniform calibration
gates.surface_criticality: near-zero ||2Qgamma+b|| regions require separate weak/critical treatment
gates.branch_conditioning: for a quadratic ray root, |partial_t Delta|=sqrt(D); small discriminant therefore creates intrinsically sensitive root branches and requires explicit conditioning diagnostics
gates.null_locality: supported but remote roots require an explicit predeclared parameter/effect/risk radius or a separately declared global estimand; no silent coefficient-norm truncation is permitted
gates.effect_locality: when a local estimand is intended, locality should be expressed in induced held-out outcome/effect units via a positive-semidefinite feature metric, not coefficient norm alone
gates.bootstrap_operator_equivalence: cached forecast operators are valid refits only under the fixed-feature linear-ridge conditions; this equivalence must not be generalized to joint feature/outcome resampling
gates.joint_feature_outcome_law: the finite-sample risk/null surface must include relevant feature/outcome cross-moments whenever the scientific DGP permits endogeneity or shared latent innovations

joint_endogeneity.design: 40 paths x 50 outcomes per path, omega 0..0.9
joint_endogeneity.finding: The independence-based nominal equal-risk root becomes increasingly non-null under controlled feature/outcome innovation correlation.

derive the joint feature/outcome finite-sample risk surface including cross-moment terms where endogeneity is scientifically plausible
establish uniform or least-favorable size control, including weak-identification and endogeneity regimes
validate the actual Rust implementation independently from the mechanics mirror
